metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects attempts to bypass conditional access policies through legacy protocols or exemption abuse
properties.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where ResultType == 0 | where ConditionalAccessPolicies has "notApplied" or ConditionalAccessPolicies has "reportOnlyMode" | where ClientAppUsed in ("Exchange ActiveSync", "IMAP", "POP3", "SMTP") | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 30m), UserPrincipalName, ClientAppUsed | where count_ > 5
